MARKET SUMMARY
INDIA
The Indian market remains positive, with buyers continuing to show interest for
available recycling tonnage. However, India currently remains the least competitive among the three
subcontinent destinations, with price levels trailing both Pakistan and Bangladesh. While buying interest is present, Indian buyers are finding it difficult to compete
against the stronger appetite and higher levels being offered by Pakistan and
Bangladesh.
